title: Formal fibres of A[x] over nonzero primes above (0), A complete local domain of characteristic p
statement: Let $p$ be a prime number and let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local domain which is $\mathfrak m$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring] and whose fraction field $K=A_{(0)}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] has characteristic $p$. Let $A[x]$ be the polynomial ring in one variable [def-weil-polynomial-ring], $\mathfrak q\subset A[x]$ a maximal ideal with $\mathfrak q\cap A=\mathfrak m$, and $\mathfrak r\subseteq\mathfrak q$ a prime ideal with $\mathfrak r\ne(0)$ and $\mathfrak r\cap A=(0)$. Let $\kappa(\mathfrak r)=A[x]_{\mathfrak r}/\mathfrak rA[x]_{\mathfrak r}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] and $(A[x]_{\mathfrak q})^\wedge=\varprojlim_nA[x]_{\mathfrak q}/\mathfrak q^nA[x]_{\mathfrak q}$ the completion of the local ring $A[x]_{\mathfrak q}$ at its maximal ideal [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Then the $\kappa(\mathfrak r)$-algebra $(A[x]_{\mathfrak q})^\wedge\otimes_{A[x]}\kappa(\mathfrak r)$ is Noetherian and geometrically regular over $\kappa(\mathfrak r)$ [def-weil-pbc-g-ring].
